description: Local goal + guardrail state. The user's ultimate goal is stored here so agents can check alignment before taking actions.
goal: Raise ZenInfer decode throughput on Zen 3 (AVX2+FMA3, no AVX-512) while keeping generated token IDs byte-identical
guardrails: Generated token IDs must stay byte-identical for the 64-token reference prompt
ctest must pass 3/3 after every change
No AVX-512: the host is Zen 3
notes: Use set_goal() to initialize, update_goal() to override guardrails, check_guardrail() to verify actions.
